NewsArticle.Title: Minor Social Enhancements
NewsArticle.Content:
Lover's Glade and Chapel: Priest may now remove a disturbance from the area. To see it, look at the faerie love, or matrimony options. It does not banish the nuisance. Use it maturely.
Political support may be given to someone in office who is not yet seeking a new office. See Cedric in Mileth Village Hall.
For priests: Beothaich deum window now only appears when you have the ingredients for beothaich deum. It used to pop up even if you did not have the ingredients, which can be frustrating at a critical moment.
